identification.reported_issue: serve_asset answers asset requests for our marketing site from the site root. Deployments keep configuration dotfiles such as .env inside that root; check whether requesting the asset name .env returns their contents. Analyze this component only.

source_files.content:
from pathlib import Path

import static_assets


def test_serves_stylesheet(tmp_path: Path):
    (tmp_path / "main.css").write_text("body {}")
    assert static_assets.serve_asset(tmp_path, "main.css") == b"body {}"

environment.scratch_location: The per-test pytest tmp_path directory; fixtures must not be created elsewhere
